description: Set a room metric's value, creating the metric when the key is new (a room holds at most 8). Sends no ping and no push. Needs a room the account owns or administers. A value equal to the stored one changes nothing and keeps its updated time. A new metric's label defaults to the key and its format to number (for a number) or text (for a string); numbers keep four decimal places. Values are raw: clients format them for the reader.

format.description: How clients show the value: number, currency (needs unit: an ISO 4217 code), percent, unit (needs unit: free text such as ms) or text. Defaults to number or text by the value's type for a new metric.

key.description: Metric key (from list_metrics): 1 to 40 characters, letters, digits, "-" and "_", starting with a letter or digit. Lowercased for you.

label.description: Name shown beside the value (at most 24 characters). Defaults to the key for a new metric.

unit.description: An ISO 4217 code such as USD for the currency format, short free text such as ms for the unit format. Not allowed for the other formats.

value.description: The value: a finite number with an absolute value of at most 1e15 for the number, currency, percent and unit formats, or a string of at most 24 characters for the text format.

name: set_metric

result.description: A room metric: a named value a widget shows. `value` is raw (a number for the numeric formats, a string for text, null until set); clients format it for the reader.

unit.description: An ISO 4217 code for the currency format, free text for the unit format, null otherwise.

value_updated_at.description: When the value last changed (ISO 8601); null until a value is set. A write of the stored value does not move it.

title: Set Metric
